label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y ahora, déjame, y arderá mi nariz en ellos, y los consumiré, y te haré a nación grande.
spanish: Y ahora, déjame, y arda mi nariz en ellos, y los consuma, y te haré a nación grande.
grammarChanges: arderá → arda (h02032010004): qal jussive 3ms carries volitive force "let it burn," not an indicative prediction; restored with Spanish subjunctive used alone for a wish/command, as in biblical register ("arda mi ira").

consumiré → consuma (h02032010007): piel cohortative 1cs carries volitive force "let me consume," not an indicative prediction; restored with the matching 1cs subjunctive, continuing the same unmarked wish construction as the prior clause.
